SSC JE Exam 2026 : Short Details of Notification

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 02/09/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 22/09/2026 upto 11 PM
  • Pay Fee Last Date : 23/09/2026
  • Correction Date : 28-30 September 2026
  • SSC JE Paper I Exam Date : October / November 2026
  • SSC JE Paper II Exam Date : December 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : 100/-
  • SC / ST / PH / Female : 0/-
  • Correction First Time : 200/-
  • Correction Second Time : 500/-
  • Pay the Exam Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI Fee Mode Only.

SSC Junior Engineer JE Notification 2026 : Age Limit as on 01/08/2026

  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 32 Years for CPWD Post Only
  • Maximum Age : 30 Years. (All Other Post)
  • Age Relaxation Extra as per Staff Selection Commission Junior Engineer Exam 2026 Rules.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q1. When did the SSC Junior Engineer JE Online Application 2026 Process Start?

  • The detailed syllabus and examination scheme are available in the official notification. Candidates are advised to read the notification carefully for complete details.
Q4. How can I download the SSC Junior Engineer JE Notification 2026 PDF?
  • Candidates can download the notification through SarkariResult.com.
Q5. What is the last date to apply online for SSC Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026?
  • The last date to apply online is 22 September 2026.
Q6. What is the last date to pay the application fee?
